photos.title: Kansas City vs. Chicago, opening day, Chicago, Federal League, baseball park, Addison & Clark Sts., April 23, 1914, attendance 28,436
photos.place: Opening day at the new ballpark at Clark and Addison

photos.caption: Kansas City vs. Chicago, opening day, Chicago, Federal League, baseball park, Addison & Clark Sts., April 23, 1914, attendance 28,436
photos.fact: The ballpark at Clark and Addison opened in 1914 for the Federal League. The Cubs moved in in 1916, and it was named Wrigley Field in 1926.

photos.fact: Finished in 1892, the 21-story Masonic Temple was for years the tallest building in Chicago. It was torn down in 1939.

photos.fact: The Auditorium Building, by Adler & Sullivan, was dedicated in 1889. Roosevelt University bought it in 1946 and still uses it.

photos.rights: No known restrictions. For information, see U.S. Farm Security Administration/Office of War Information Black & White Photographs https://www.loc.gov/rr/print/res/071_fsab.html
